title: Bonus and Care tools
description: Adds unique tools that has effects on you, someone else or whatever the tool interacted with
body:
# Bonus & Care Tools

Welcome to **Bonus & Care**! This mod introduces a powerful set of custom tools and specialized agricultural blocks designed to dynamically alter how you interact with the world around you. Every tool features an active ability that triggers unique effects on you, on other entities, or directly onto the blocks you interact with.

---

## Feature Breakdown

### Combat Tools
* **Speed-Boosted Sword:** Earn substantial attack speed recovery boosts whenever you land a critical jump attack on an enemy.
* **Health Stealer Sword:** Steal health directly from defeated mobs to survive longer mid-battle.

### Mining & Excavation
* **Combo Pickaxe:** Keep up a continuous mining streak to build up a high-speed turbo mining combo meter.
* **Catalyst Pickaxe:** Automatically converts raw collected experience points directly into instant health restoration.
* **Sprinter's Shovel:** Safely stack a passive running speed boost as you clear away blocks.

### Foraging & Farming
* **Alchemist's Axe:** Drops speed-potions as you chop logs to keep your pace moving through dense forests.
* **Botanist's Axe:** Dynamically drops bonus bonemeal while chopping trees to support local replanting.
* **Hyperspeed Hoe:** Actively forces crops to accelerate their growth cycles instantly upon use.

### Specialized Farmlands
* **Bonuspad Farmland:** Automatically accelerates the random growth ticks of any crops planted on top of it.
* **Carepad Farmland:** Increases overall agricultural luck, forcing harvested crops to drop significantly more ingredients.
---

## **HOW TO USE THE BONUS AND CARE SMITHING TABLE**

![How to use the bonus and care smithing table:](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/84c0d459dfd7bb8e6c9c6e5be94f4ca2ce03a99c.png)

### In the first slot, place the BonusPad Ingot. 
### In the second slot, place your iron tool. (the custom smithing table only accepts iron tools, nothing else) 
### In the third slot, place the CarePad Ingot.

# Here's how to make all of the hybrid tools:

| Output Tool | Input Tool | Required Bonuspad Ingots | Required Carepad Ingots |
| :--- | :--- | :---: | :---: |
| **Hybrid Sword** | 1x Iron Sword | 2 | 2 |
| **Hybrid Pickaxe** | 1x Iron Pickaxe | 3 | 3 |
| **Hybrid Axe** | 1x Iron Axe | 3 | 3 |
| **Hybrid Shovel** | 1x Iron Shovel | 1 | 1 |
| **Hybrid Hoe** | 1x Iron Hoe | 2 | 2 |

## Requirements & Compatibility
* **Side Compatibility:** Required on **both** Client and Server environments.
* **Dependencies:** Requires **Fabric API (0.100.1 or higher)**.
* **Synergy:** Works perfectly alongside **Die Of Death** (Optional)
